subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw approve a read-only, agent-scoped workspace file RPC and mobile browser now, separate from the broader full-CRUD workspace API?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but exposing arbitrary workspace reads through Gateway and mobile apps changes a security boundary and the item is protected by the maintainer label with multiple open implementation candidates.

options.title: Approve Read-Only Mobile Slice
options.body: Land a bounded agents.workspace read/list contract plus iOS and Android browse, preview, and share support while leaving write/delete/upload to the broader API thread.

options.title: Defer To Full Workspace API
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers approve or replace the broader workspace-management API direction tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/62417.

options.title: Keep Existing Boundaries
options.body: Reject mobile workspace browsing for now and preserve the current bootstrap-file and session-touched-file access model.

recommendation.title: Approve Read-Only Mobile Slice
recommendation.body: Land a bounded agents.workspace read/list contract plus iOS and Android browse, preview, and share support while leaving write/delete/upload to the broader API thread.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected request and authored the stacked candidate PRs that define the proposed narrow API and mobile UX.
